_meta.keys: Key n: ML-DSA-65 seed [n]*32, Ed25519 seed [n+100]*32. Holders A,B,C,D = 1,2,3,4; seats 11,12; witnesses 21,22,23; stranger 9; A's other key 31; C's rotated key 33; recovery key of holder n = n+50.
_meta.verdicts: valid | invalid (token genesis_bundle_malformed, detail = reason) | waiting {rows, prev, kids} | nothing (token; detail = the row or custody fault)

cases.description: The first bundle: three holders, two seats, every holder signed, thumbprint anchor.
The same bundle under its object id as the anchor.
The valid bundle and a fourth statement by a key in no role: refused, the rest stand.
Witnessed mode on: three witnesses, quorum 2, each witness's record cited.
Two of three holders signed a first bundle: the count is unmet.
C's statement carries iat one second late: that statement is refused (iat_mismatch); the count is unmet. CC's reference reader answers Invalid iat_mismatch for the bundle.
C's statement carries no iat: refused before grouping; the count is unmet.
C's signature has one byte flipped: refused; the count is unmet.
A's statement names A's iss but is signed under another key: refused in a first bundle.
A row statement offered as a bundle voice: refused; the count is unmet.
A statement of typ ceg-revocation-snapshot/2 over the same payload: refused.
A holder set unlike the thumbprint anchor: not anchored.
An object id unlike the anchor: not anchored.
A reader with no anchor promotes nothing to a root.
Seat 1's key record is named but not held: Waiting on it.
A row held under another id than the one named: the named row is not held.
Seat 2's binding is not in cites: a seat with no binding, unplaced.
A stranger's key record named in cites: a row with no place.
Two key records by holder A: two rows for one place.
Seat 1's key record with a flipped signature byte (same row id): Invalid as a row.
Seat 1's record is node + pseudonym, not exactly node.
Seat 1's node record has no valid_until: key_record_out_of_window.
Holder B's record carries user, not accord_holder.
Holder A's record (author A) records another key: not A's genesis key.
Holder A's record signed by B's key: not signed by the key it records.
CC sample: a pq_custody outside the three (token): the record is refused.
CC sample: a chain in hex (text, not bytes): the record is refused.
CC sample: an empty chain: the record is refused.
Holder A's ML-DSA half software_wrapped: fails the gate.
Holder B's chain verifies only to a root the reader does not trust.
Holder C's chain attests an Ed25519 key that is not its record's half.
Holder A's f9 certificate carries no FIPS extension: the floor is not met.
Holder A asserts YubiKey_5_FIPS with no chain: unattested, not seated.
Holder A's record carries no attestation_evidence: no class, not seated.
Seat 1's binding (author S1) signed by seat 2's key.
transit_xwing_pubkey of 1215 bytes.
No onion_hop_xwing_pubkey.
The onion key's X25519 half equals the transit key's.
The transit key's X25519 half is the RNS link x25519.
The onion key's X25519 half is the seat's own Ed25519 half.
The binding also carries the earlier transit_kex_pubkeys pair.
The seat carries onion_relay.opt_out: seat_opted_out.
An identity:occurrence by the seat with no transport_destination.
version 2 with no prev.
version 1 with a prev.

A seat also listed as a witness.
Commitments keyed by two of the three holders.
scope without infra:attest.
witnesses and witness_quorum without witness_cadence_secs.

holders not in CDE order.
A cites row-ref of edition 1.
halt_fuse_secs 0.
Version 2: C swapped for D; a strict majority of the predecessor's holders (A, B) and D sign.
A and the removed holder C (under its key from the predecessor) are the majority; D, the added holder, signs.
A and B sign but D, the added holder, does not: the count is unmet.
A and D only: one of three predecessor holders is no majority.
C signs under a key C rotated to (not held, not in the predecessor): Waiting on it.
The predecessor is not held: Waiting on it.
The predecessor is held and not Valid: the bundle concludes nothing.
Version 3 naming a version-1 predecessor.
A later bundle with another family_key_id.
B's recovery commitment changes but B does not sign (A and C do).
B's recovery commitment changes and B signs, with A.
A and the stranger X sign: X has no role, A alone is no majority.
Two first bundles every anchored holder signed: both Valid, a fork of the genesis.
The same two first bundles under an object-id anchor: the other is void.
Two Valid version-2 bundles naming one prev: a fork.
The valid version-2 bundle over its predecessor: the head is version 2.
